decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Prior to first use of the buildings for B8 Storage and Distribution use hereby approved, the proposed car and commercial vehicle parking spaces and cycle parking spaces will be implemented as set out in figure 4 of the planning statement and these will be maintained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 2 - During the construction phase, footway and carriageway of the nearby Dick Turpin Way and Great South West Road, which form part of the Transport for London Road Network (TLRN) must remain clear at all times.

Condition : 3 - Any vehicles associated with the construction or day to day running of the development must not park/load/unload on the footway/carriageway of Dick Turpin Way or Great South West Road at any time.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Prior notification for the change of use of four agricultural buildings to use as Storage and Distribution (Use class B8)
